# fw-files crate

> Terminal file manager engine distilled from yazi: metadata, natural sorting, MIME detection, yazi's previewer rule table, previews, a worker-pool scheduler…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-files/

Terminal file manager engine distilled from yazi: metadata, natural sorting, MIME detection, yazi's previewer rule table, previews, a worker-pool scheduler for copy/move/remove with progress events, and SFTP through yazi-sftp. Every command reads paths and writes JSON lines.
